verified.entry_point: Confirmed offline at the pinned+injected commit: a map key or name taken from text format, JSON, a .proto schema, a descriptor set, a settings write or a code-generation run reaches the owning object's inherited shape (or, for a name that merely coincides with an inherited member, is read as if it were data). Every lever was driven through the public API the report names; no network.

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: every site writes a name onto the object that name belongs to (the map, the message, the options bag, the generated table); there is no neighbouring or proxy resource to authorise instead of the object being written.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: a name-to-key confusion has no peer, role or direction dimension; the levers differ by input language and API, each with its own test.
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: map keys pass through a per-key-type normaliser that returns the key unchanged for string keys and a number for integer keys; there is no earlier lossy step a guard could be placed after that would silently defeat it.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the input is a name, not a parsed identity whose malformed spelling could make a guard see nothing; the one special spelling is the exact key the report already shows.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: there is no external authority (secret store, role lookup) whose empty answer could make a guard fail open.
